tolerance_overrides.reason: The quietest instrument of the library (mean level about -60 dBFS, a kit of noise-like samples). sfizz writes 16-bit; the harness puts the engine on the same grid (--candidate-quantize), and a float difference of about 0.02 LSB (about -63 dB relative to the signal, no lag, gain 1.00003) becomes 1 to 4 percent single-LSB mismatches, which cost linearly in the residual: -49.4 .. -54.5 dB on the worst probes instead of the -63 dB of the float difference. -45 dB still fails a gain error of about 0.01 dB, a wrong sample or layer, or a timing error.
